items.source:
A RuntimeException thrown by the callback is treated as application
exception that enforces a rollback. An exception gets propagated to the
caller of the template.
items.translation: 由回调抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为强制回滚的应用程序异常。该异常会传播到模板的调用者。

items.source:
Note when using JTA: JTA transactions only work with transactional
JNDI resources, so implementations need to use such resources if they
want transaction support.
items.translation: 注意在使用 JTA 时：JTA 事务仅适用于事务型 JNDI 资源，因此实现若需要事务支持，则必须使用此类资源。

items.source:
Simple convenience class for TransactionCallback implementation.
Allows for implementing a doInTransaction version without result,
i.e. without the need for a return statement.
items.translation: 简单的便利类，用于实现 `TransactionCallback`。允许实现不带结果的 `doInTransaction` 版本，即无需返回语句。

items.source: doInTransaction in interface TransactionCallback<@Nullable Object>
items.translation: doInTransaction 接口中的 TransactionCallback<@Nullable Object>

items.source:
Allows for returning a result object created within the transaction, i.e. a
domain object or a collection of domain objects. A RuntimeException thrown by the
callback is treated as application exception that enforces a rollback. Any such
exception will be propagated to the caller of the template, unless there is a
problem rolling back, in which case a TransactionException will be thrown.
items.translation: 允许返回在事务内创建的结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。由回调抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为强制回滚的应用程序异常。此类异常将传播到模板的调用者，除非回滚过程中出现问题，此时将抛出 TransactionException。

items.source: Gets called by TransactionTemplate.execute(TransactionCallback) within a transactional context.
items.translation: 在事务上下文中由 `TransactionTemplate.execute(TransactionCallback)` 调用。

items.source: Gets called by TransactionTemplate.execute within a transactional context.
